title: ヴィクトリアマイルの後に・新たな輝き

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the last stretch of the Victoria Mile, Vodka stirs the audience by showing off her astounding dash.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka is thrilled and enthralled by her ability to pass the other Umamusume in a flash.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka realizes that this dash is the weapon she's been looking for. She decides to continue on to the Yasuda Kinen to further polish this skill.
